attributes.action: Upgrade the M2 between J4 and J7 to improve road safety and increase capacity.
attributes.additional_details: The M2 is a vital route for Medway, Swale and east Kent, yet sections between J4 and J7 remain only two lanes in each direction. We want an urgent independent safety review, action on collision hotspots, improved incident warnings and safer traffic management. The Government must recognise the growing pressure from traffic and development, and commit to widening both carriageways to three lanes, with funding and a clear timetable. Local communities deserve a safer, more reliable motorway.
attributes.background: We call on the Government and National Highways to urgently introduce safety improvements on the M2 between J4 and J7, Gillingham to Faversham, and commit to widening both carriageways to three lanes, with a funded programme and clear delivery timetable.

rejection.details: We aren't able to accept petitions which deal with local issues.
